question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Great accomplishment includes enjoyment and liberation
Such accomplishment can arise for a practitioner
This attainment brings favor with the yoginīs
inference: One who attains great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
